action.description: Whether accounts matching the subject may chat (allow) or may not (deny). Deny wins over allow.

subject.description: Who the rule matches. Open: a node ignores subject types it does not understand.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this rule was created.

main.description: A rule about who may chat on this streamer's streams. Rules are evaluated per streamer: when any allow rule exists, only accounts matching an allow rule may chat; accounts matching a deny rule never may. A streamer with no rules has open chat.

value.description: The label value that matches; a trailing * matches any label with that prefix.

label.description: Accounts carrying this label from this labeler. A node that sees a rule naming a labeler starts mirroring its matching labels.

verifier.description: Accounts that hold an app.bsky.graph.verification record issued by this DID. A node that sees a rule naming a verifier starts indexing that verifier's records.
